# aoss_trunk (Resource)

Manages a trunk circuit: a named set of ports operating in trunk or LACP mode.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "aoss_trunk" "uplink" {
  ports = [9, 10]
  name  = "trk1"
  mode  = "lacp"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The trunk name; must be of the form trk<N>.
- `ports` (Set of Number) The switch ports that make up the trunk: a set of port numbers.

### Optional

- `mode` (String) The trunk mode: "trunk" or "lacp" (default).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
